headline: 10 dead in avalanche: Body of climber Nirmal Purja recovered from Broad Peak
summary: The world-renowned British-Nepali climber was among 10 people killed in a massive avalanche on one of the world's highest peaks in northern Pakistan.
details: Rescuers have recovered the body of renowned climber Nirmal Purja after a devastating avalanche killed him and nine other team members on Broad Peak in northern Pakistan.
The avalanche struck on Thursday, cutting off all contact with the international expedition led by the 43-year-old British-Nepali climber.
A ground rescue team located Purja's body at approximately 5,700 meters on the mountain he loved, according to the Alpine Club of Pakistan.
The rescue team is currently transporting four bodies down from the mountain, including Purja, two other Nepali nationals, and one Chinese citizen.
Rescuers have also confirmed the presence of one additional body at a significantly higher elevation on the peak.
The tragedy marks a significant loss to the global mountaineering community, as Purja was known for his record-breaking climbs and leadership in high-altitude expeditions.
caption:
10 climbers killed in a massive avalanche on Broad Peak. The body of world-renowned climber Nirmal Purja has been recovered.

Rescuers have recovered the body of renowned climber Nirmal Purja after a devastating avalanche killed him and nine other team members on Broad Peak in northern Pakistan.

The avalanche struck on Thursday, cutting off all contact with the international expedition led by the 43-year-old British-Nepali climber.

A ground rescue team located Purja's body at approximately 5,700 meters on the mountain he loved, according to the Alpine Club of Pakistan.

The rescue team is currently transporting four bodies down from the mountain, including Purja, two other Nepali nationals, and one Chinese citizen.

Rescuers have also confirmed the presence of one additional body at a significantly higher elevation on the peak.

The tragedy marks a significant loss to the global mountaineering community, as Purja was known for his record-breaking climbs and leadership in high-altitude expeditions.
